How to generate a radiology inoive?

To generate a radiology invoice, choose the service for billing from the service list, enter the item code or name for the radiology service, select the item from the list, and click on the “Add” button. The added items will be displayed on the grid below. Then, follow the payment process as outlined, which includes clicking the ‘Save’ button to generate the invoice bill with a bill number.
